resources.string: This TV can\'t decode this video
This TV has no hardware decoder for this film\'s video track, so it was never started. Your phone and your Wi-Fi are both fine — an H.264 or HEVC copy plays here.
This TV can\'t take this video track
The film reached this TV and its decoder wouldn\'t accept this video track — it may simply be larger than this TV can handle. Nothing is wrong with your phone or your Wi-Fi.
This TV can\'t play Dolby Vision
The video track is Dolby Vision and this TV can\'t decode that profile. An HDR10 or SDR copy of the same film plays here.
This TV can\'t open this file
This TV couldn\'t read the container the film is wrapped in, so it never reached a decoder. The film itself may be fine — an MP4 copy usually plays.
This film\'s data wouldn\'t decode
The bytes arrived and this TV couldn\'t make sense of them partway through. This copy of the film is probably incomplete or damaged.
This TV couldn\'t start a decoder
This TV wouldn\'t open a decoder for this film, even after trying a second one. Nothing is wrong with your phone or the file.
Another app took this TV\'s decoder
Something else on this TV claimed the video decoder while the film was playing. Close it, then start the film again from your phone.
Something else on this TV claimed the video decoder before the film could start. Close it, then start the film again from your phone.
This TV\'s sound output refused the film
The picture was fine — this TV\'s sound output wouldn\'t take this film\'s audio, sent as it is or decoded here first. Check where this TV is sending sound, then start the film again from your phone.

This TV\'s sound output wouldn\'t take this film\'s audio, sent as it is or decoded here first, so the film was never started. Check where this TV is sending sound, then start the film again from your phone.
This TV didn\'t reach the first frame
The film was accepted and the first bytes arrived, but no picture reached this screen in time. Your phone can start it again.
Your phone wouldn\'t hand over the file
%1$s answered this TV and turned the request for the film down. The address it was given for the film may simply have expired — start it again from your phone.
Your phone\'s file server didn\'t answer
%1$s is talking to this TV, but its file server didn\'t answer at all. Either it just dropped off the Wi-Fi, or your router is keeping the two apart.
%1$s is talking to this TV, but its file server never handed the film over. Start it again from your phone.
Your phone stopped talking to this TV
The connection to %1$s dropped, so this TV stopped the film. It may have gone to sleep, or your router may be keeping the two apart — start it again from your phone.
The connection to %1$s dropped before the film started. It may have gone to sleep, or your router may be keeping the two apart.
This TV\'s network address changed
The film stopped because the address this TV was reachable on went away. Give it a moment to settle, then cast again from %1$s.
The cast couldn\'t start because the address this TV was reachable on went away. Give it a moment to settle, then cast again from %1$s.
The picture stopped on this TV
No new picture reached this screen while the film was still playing. This TV already tried to restart the video on its own — start the film again from your phone.
This TV couldn\'t play this film
The film stopped and this TV didn\'t get a reason it can explain. Your phone and your Wi-Fi may both be fine.
